answer: Sybil resistance can be built by binding each agent identity to a scarce physical token: a ferrous hardware key whose private secret seeds a unique on-chain thread. Registration requires burning a small proof-of-work stake, so forging thousands of identities costs real compute and hardware. The whole scheme resembles a fable about many masks with one face, since each key can only ever anchor a single verified agent. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
